# platform.claude.com documentation — Manage Claude

> 40 page(s) of platform.claude.com documentation under Manage Claude. Part of the index one level up (../llms.txt).

## Manage Claude

- [API keys](https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/manage-claude/authentication.md): API keys are static secrets that you generate in the Claude Console and send on every request in the `x-api-key` header.
- [How Access Transparency works](https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/manage-claude/access-transparency.md): Anthropic personnel access customer content only under defined conditions. Access Transparency is designed to make such access visible to you.
- [Authentication](https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/manage-claude/admin-api.md): Authenticate with any of the three credentials. An Admin API key covers most endpoints.
- [Which API do you need?](https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/manage-claude/analytics-api.md): The Claude Code Analytics API is available to every organization with access to the [Admin API](https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/manage-claude/admin-api), and is free to use.
- [How Anthropic approaches data retention](https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/manage-claude/api-and-data-retention.md): Different APIs and features have different storage needs. Where a feature does not require storage of customer prompts or responses, it may be eligible for ZDR.
- [How App Attest works](https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/manage-claude/app-attest.md): Each installation of your app uses Apple's [App Attest](https://developer.apple.com/documentation/devicecheck/establishing-your-app-s-integrity) service to prove that it is a…

- [How the Compliance API works](https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/manage-claude/compliance-api.md): Every endpoint lives under `/v1/compliance/*` on `https://api.anthropic.com` and authenticates through the `x-api-key` header.
- [Access and scopes](https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/manage-claude/compliance-faq.md): To enable the Compliance API, see [Set up the Compliance API](https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/manage-claude/compliance-api-access).

- [Which key do you need?](https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/manage-claude/admin-api-keys.md): Only organization members with the **admin** role can create Admin API keys.
- [How it works](https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/manage-claude/cmek.md): Only Organization Admins (on Claude Platform; the Admin role on Claude Platform on AWS) or Owners and the Primary Owner (on Claude Enterprise) can configure CMEK.
- [Inference geo](https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/manage-claude/data-residency.md): For how zero data retention (ZDR) applies to this feature, see [API and data retention](https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/manage-claude/api-and-data-retention).

- [400 Bad Request](https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/manage-claude/compliance-errors.md): The request was syntactically valid but contained a parameter the server rejected. Fix the parameter and retry.

- [Prerequisites](https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/manage-claude/wif-admin-api.md): Every request on this page authenticates with an OAuth bearer token that carries the `org:admin` scope.
- [Filter activities](https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/manage-claude/compliance-activity-feed.md): Filter by organization, actor, activity type, or a `created_at` time window using the dotted sub-parameters `created_at.gte`, `.gt`, `.lte`, and `.lt`.

- [Which key do you need?](https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/manage-claude/compliance-api-access.md): Setup is one flow: enable the Compliance API for your organization, then create a Compliance Access Key in claude.ai.

- [Prerequisites](https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/manage-claude/wif-providers/aws.md): The AWS STS `GetWebIdentityToken` API returns an OIDC token signed by AWS that asserts the caller's IAM identity.
- [Prerequisites](https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/manage-claude/wif-providers/github-actions.md): GitHub only issues an identity token to jobs that explicitly request it. Add the `id-token: write` permission at the workflow or job level:
- [Prerequisites](https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/manage-claude/wif-providers/gcp.md): Google issues identity tokens automatically to any workload with an attached service account.
- [Prerequisites](https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/manage-claude/wif-providers/kubernetes.md): Project a service account token into your pod with the audience and lifetime that your federation rule expects.
- [Prerequisites](https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/manage-claude/wif-providers/azure.md): Microsoft Entra ID only issues a token when the requested audience exists in your tenant as an app registration with a service principal.
- [Prerequisites](https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/manage-claude/wif-providers/okta.md): In the Claude Console, open **Settings → Workload identity**, click **Connect workload**, and select **Custom OIDC**.
- [Prerequisites](https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/manage-claude/wif-providers/spiffe.md): The instructions in this section are SPIRE-specific.
- [Which endpoints can your organization use?](https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/manage-claude/user-management.md): The Admin API is a single set of endpoints under `https://api.anthropic.com/v1/organizations/`.
- [Token exchange request](https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/manage-claude/wif-reference.md): `POST /v1/oauth/token` accepts a JSON body using the [RFC 7523](https://www.rfc-editor.org/rfc/rfc7523) `jwt-bearer` grant.
- [Concepts](https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/manage-claude/workload-identity-federation.md): You configure three resources in the Claude Console before any workload can federate.
- [How workspaces work](https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/manage-claude/workspaces.md): Every organization has a **Default Workspace** that cannot be renamed, archived, or deleted.
